NAVIGATION.description: ESDF 地图路径；地图不存在时服务将进入异常模式
NAVIGATION.description_en: ESDF map path; if the map does not exist, the service enters an error state

NAVIGATION.description: 是否禁用动态地图（开启/关闭动态避障功能）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to disable the dynamic map (turns dynamic obstacle avoidance on/off)

NAVIGATION.description: 启用静态地图规划：路径搜索在静态地图中进行，动态地图仅用于实时碰撞检测；遭遇障碍物阻挡时停障而非绕障
NAVIGATION.description_en: Enable static-map planning: path search runs on the static map, the dynamic map is only used for real-time collision checking; when blocked by an obstacle the robot stops instead of going around it

NAVIGATION.description: 是否在动态地图层进行点位可达预估（开启后同时在动态图层评估可达性；关闭时仅用静态图层评估）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to perform reachability estimation on the dynamic map layer (when enabled, reachability is also evaluated on the dynamic layer; when disabled, only the static layer is used)

NAVIGATION.description: 规划失败或运行中检测到碰撞时是否立即上报失败、不再进行重规划尝试
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to immediately report failure (without attempting to replan) when planning fails or a collision is detected during execution

NAVIGATION.description: 单次导航请求的全局超时时间，超过该时间未完成则判定导航失败并上报；正值为超时时长，非正值表示不设超时、允许无限重规划
NAVIGATION.description_en: Global timeout for a single navigation request; if not completed within this time, the request is reported as failed. A positive value is the timeout duration; a non-positive value means no timeout (unlimited replanning is allowed)

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用动态连续重规划（Beta）：开启后重规划时不下发停止指令，以上一次轨迹执行位置为起始条件连续重规划，避障运动更连续；关闭（默认）则先停止底盘再重规划
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable continuous dynamic replanning (Beta): when enabled, no stop command is issued during replanning -- the last executed trajectory position is used as the starting condition so obstacle-avoidance motion stays continuous; when disabled (default), the base stops before replanning

NAVIGATION.description: 当前位置距离起始点小于该阈值时不进行重规划；replan_threshold + no_replan_threshold 之和须小于 planning_horizen，否则主动重规划会失效
NAVIGATION.description_en: Replanning is skipped once the current position is closer than this threshold to the starting point; replan_threshold + no_replan_threshold must be less than planning_horizen, otherwise active replanning stops working

NAVIGATION.description: 当前位置距离目标点小于该阈值时不进行重规划；过小容易在接近目标点时因重规划引起轨迹抖动
NAVIGATION.description_en: Replanning is skipped once the current position is closer than this threshold to the goal; too small a value can cause trajectory jitter from replanning near the goal

NAVIGATION.description: 局部规划视界，每次仅规划该范围内的路径；超出部分按此长度截断，分多段完成导航
NAVIGATION.description_en: Local planning horizon; only the path within this range is planned each time. Anything beyond it is truncated to this length and completed over multiple replanning segments

NAVIGATION.description: 路径搜索失败时，返回的部分路径与障碍物保持的距离；若大于可行通道宽度的一半，该区域将被视为不可达区域
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept from obstacles for the partial path returned when path search fails; if larger than half the width of a feasible corridor, that area is treated as unreachable

NAVIGATION.description: 左臂末端工具类型，用于导航规划时纳入末端工具与环境的碰撞检测：0=None，1=gripper_hitbot，2=suction_cup，3=robotiq_gripper，4=galbot_gripper，5=GE103，6=GE103v1（默认 0，不考虑碰撞）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Left-arm end-effector tool type, used to include the end-effector in environment collision checking during navigation planning: 0=None, 1=gripper_hitbot, 2=suction_cup, 3=robotiq_gripper, 4=galbot_gripper, 5=GE103, 6=GE103v1 (default 0, collision not considered)

NAVIGATION.description: 右臂末端工具类型，含义同 left_arm
NAVIGATION.description_en: Right-arm end-effector tool type, same meaning as left_arm

NAVIGATION.description: 路径点与障碍物的距离（硬约束）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept between path points and obstacles (hard constraint)

NAVIGATION.description: 路径搜索阶段，起始点特化范围半径
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the start point, during path search

NAVIGATION.description: 路径搜索阶段，目标点特化范围半径
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the goal point, during path search

NAVIGATION.description: 起始特化范围内点位与障碍物距离，适配起始点接近障碍物的情况
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the start-point specialized radius, for cases where the starting point is close to an obstacle

NAVIGATION.description: 目标特化范围内点位与障碍物距离，适配目标点接近障碍物的情况
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the goal-point specialized radius, for cases where the goal is close to an obstacle

NAVIGATION.description: 路径搜索失败（通路被阻挡）时，是否返回可行域内距目标点最近的部分路径；目标点在货架/墙壁对面等场景慎用，可能出现"走错位置"的观感
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to return the feasible partial path closest to the goal when path search fails (path blocked); use with caution when the goal is behind a shelf/wall, as it can look like the robot went to the wrong place

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 路径控制点与障碍物距离（软约束）；应大于搜索阶段的安全距离，一般大 0.2~0.5m
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept between path control points and obstacles (soft constraint); should be greater than the search-phase safety distance, typically by 0.2~0.5m

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 起始特化范围内点位与障碍物距离
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the start-point specialized radius

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 目标特化范围内点位与障碍物距离
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the goal-point specialized radius

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹优化阶段，起始点特化范围
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the start point, during trajectory optimization

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹优化阶段，目标点特化范围
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the goal point, during trajectory optimization

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹优化后验硬约束：最终规划路径点与障碍物距离小于该值则判定规划失败
NAVIGATION.description_en: Post-optimization hard constraint: planning is judged to have failed if the final planned path's distance to an obstacle is below this value

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 障碍物距离权重（安全性权重），默认以安全性为优先，数值越大越优先避障
NAVIGATION.description_en: Obstacle-distance weight (safety weight); by default safety is prioritized, and a larger value further prioritizes obstacle avoidance

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.range: 数值越大轨迹越平滑，20.0~50.0 通常有较好效果
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹平滑性权重；场景宽敞、无需贴近障碍物时可适当调高以提升导航流畅度
NAVIGATION.description_en: Trajectory smoothness weight; can be increased in open scenes that don't require hugging obstacles closely, to improve navigation smoothness

NAVIGATION.description: 导航执行时，沿规划路径基于机器人当前位置向前预测检测碰撞的距离；预测距离过大易导致频繁重规划、运动卡顿或抖动
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance ahead of the robot's current position, along the planned path, over which collisions are predicted during navigation execution; too large a value can cause frequent replanning or jerky/stuttering motion

NAVIGATION.description: 规划完成时是否检测全轨迹（圆柱包络）碰撞可行性，不可行则不下发控制执行；高动态响应/无图长程导航等场景可关闭，改为运行时碰撞预测+动态重规划配合使用
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to check the full trajectory (cylindrical envelope) for collision feasibility once planning completes, and withhold execution if infeasible; can be disabled in high dynamic-response or mapless long-range navigation scenarios in favor of runtime collision prediction + dynamic replanning

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.range: 长度 3，单位 m/s、rad/s，元素范围 (0, 1.5)
NAVIGATION.description: 导航规划最大速度 [vx, vy, w]；需同步保证机器人控制端速度上限不小于此值，否则可能出现跟踪不上的情况
NAVIGATION.description_en: Maximum navigation planning velocity [vx, vy, w]; the robot's control-side velocity limit must be kept no lower than this value, otherwise the robot may fail to track the planned velocity
NAVIGATION.range_en: length 3, in m/s and rad/s, element range (0, 1.5)

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 导航规划最大加速度 [ax, ay, aw]；一般不修改
NAVIGATION.description_en: Maximum navigation planning acceleration [ax, ay, aw]; normally left unchanged

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 导航规划最大加加速度 [jx, jy, jw]；一般不修改
NAVIGATION.description_en: Maximum navigation planning jerk [jx, jy, jw]; normally left unchanged

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用向心加速度约束
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable the centripetal acceleration constraint

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 向心加速度约束上限
NAVIGATION.description_en: Upper bound for the centripetal acceleration constraint

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 规划路点时间间隔（控制周期），决定路点密集程度
NAVIGATION.description_en: Time interval between planned waypoints (control cycle), determining how densely waypoints are packed

NAVIGATION.description: 到达位置误差（X 方向）；需保证机器人控制精度小于此处到位误差，否则会触发无法到位问题，控制精度不宜小于 1cm
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival position error (X direction); the robot's control accuracy must be smaller than this arrival error, otherwise the robot may fail to reach the target; control accuracy should not be smaller than 1cm

NAVIGATION.description: 到达位置误差（Y 方向）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival position error (Y direction)

NAVIGATION.description: 到达角度误差
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival orientation error

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用全向规划（同时平移与旋转）；关闭时为常规航向导航（先转向再直行）。受限于雷达可视范围，全向运动背对障碍物行进时存在碰撞风险，需结合场景判断是否开启。S1 机型传入会返回 INVALID_INPUT
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable omnidirectional planning (simultaneous translation and rotation); when disabled, standard heading-based navigation (turn first, then move straight) is used. Due to limited lidar field of view, moving omnidirectionally with an obstacle behind the robot carries a collision risk -- enable based on the scene. On S1 this returns INVALID_INPUT

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m（G系列默认 0.2，S1 默认 0.5）
NAVIGATION.description: 短位移判定阈值：当前位置与目标位置距离小于该值时，采用短位移运动方式
NAVIGATION.description_en: Short-distance-move threshold: once the distance between the current position and target is below this value, the short-distance motion mode is used

NAVIGATION.description: 短位移运动方式：0=全向（G系列），1=蟹行+旋转，2=旋转+蟹行（S1 推荐，避免关节碰撞）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Short-distance motion mode: 0=omnidirectional (G-series), 1=crab-walk + rotate, 2=rotate + crab-walk (recommended for S1, avoids joint collisions)

NAVIGATION.description: 是否优先尝试全向（S1 为旋转+蟹行）直线运动到达，无碰撞则执行，否则进入常规规划流程
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to first attempt a straight-line omnidirectional move (rotate + crab-walk on S1) to the goal, executing it if collision-free, otherwise falling back to regular planning

NAVIGATION.description: 尝试全向直线路点与障碍物保持的距离
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept from obstacles for the straight-line omnidirectional waypoints attempted above

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m；≥0 生效（建议 0.2），<0 关闭
NAVIGATION.description: 规划首末位置与障碍物（机器人或指定 link 圆柱包络表面）保持的距离；需结合 find_valid_pos_step 一并设置
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept between the start/end positions and obstacles (the robot's or a specified link's cylindrical envelope surface) during planning; should be set together with find_valid_pos_step
NAVIGATION.range_en: in m; ≥0 enables it (recommended 0.2), <0 disables it

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m；≥0 生效（建议 0.05），<0 关闭
NAVIGATION.description: 首末与障碍物保持距离无法达成（窄通道）时，搜索最佳安全距离的步长；需结合 dis_with_obstacle 一并设置
NAVIGATION.description_en: Step size for searching the best safe distance when the requested start/end obstacle clearance can't be achieved (narrow corridors); should be set together with dis_with_obstacle
NAVIGATION.range_en: in m; ≥0 enables it (recommended 0.05), <0 disables it

NAVIGATION.description: 起点查找远离点时，纳入包络检测的 link 列表
NAVIGATION.description_en: Link list included in envelope checking when searching for a clearance point near the start

NAVIGATION.description: 终点查找远离点时，纳入包络检测的 link 列表；指定较小的 link 列表可避免上身姿态臂展较大时圆柱包络半径过大而插入冗余过渡点
NAVIGATION.description_en: Link list included in envelope checking when searching for a clearance point near the goal; a smaller link list avoids inserting redundant transition points caused by an oversized cylindrical envelope when the upper body's arm span is large

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用脱困调整（导航规划路径碰撞时进入脱困策略）；开启时若同时开启静态地图规划，停障功能将失效
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable recovery adjustment (entering a recovery strategy when the planned path collides); when enabled, if static-map planning is also enabled, the stop-on-obstacle behavior stops working

NAVIGATION.description: 脱困策略尝试顺序：0=指定过渡点导航，1=直接全向（S1 为旋转+蟹行）直线到达，2=按碰撞位置搜索可原地旋转点，3=按碰撞位置分类处理
NAVIGATION.description_en: Order in which recovery strategies are attempted: 0=navigate to a designated transition point, 1=go straight omnidirectionally (rotate + crab-walk on S1), 2=search for an in-place rotation point based on the collision location, 3=handle by collision-location category

NAVIGATION.description: 到达远离障碍物过渡点尝试的运动方式，按配置顺序依次尝试：0=全向（G系列），1=蟹行+旋转，2=旋转+蟹行
NAVIGATION.description_en: Motion modes attempted, in configured order, to reach a transition point away from the obstacle: 0=omnidirectional (G-series), 1=crab-walk + rotate, 2=rotate + crab-walk

NAVIGATION.description: 指定脱困过渡点位姿列表，每项为 [x,y,yaw] 或 [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,rw]；设置多个时选运行耗时最短的可行点
NAVIGATION.description_en: List of designated recovery transition-point poses, each [x,y,yaw] or [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,rw]; when multiple are set, the fastest feasible one is chosen

NAVIGATION.description: 是否保存每次导航的过程数据（动态地图、碰撞时局部地图、规划路径），用于问题复现与可视化排查
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to save each navigation run's process data (dynamic map, local map at time of collision, planned path), for reproducing issues and visual debugging

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用动态连续重规划（Beta）：开启后重规划时不下发停止指令，以上一次轨迹执行位置为起始条件连续重规划，避障运动更连续；关闭（默认）则先停止底盘再重规划
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable continuous dynamic replanning (Beta): when enabled, no stop command is issued during replanning -- the last executed trajectory position is used as the starting condition so obstacle-avoidance motion stays continuous; when disabled (default), the base stops before replanning

NAVIGATION.description: 当前位置距离起始点小于该阈值时不进行重规划；replan_threshold + no_replan_threshold 之和须小于 planning_horizen，否则主动重规划会失效

NAVIGATION.description: 当前位置距离目标点小于该阈值时不进行重规划；过小容易在接近目标点时因重规划引起轨迹抖动

NAVIGATION.description: 路径搜索阶段，起始点特化范围半径
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the start point, during path search

NAVIGATION.description: 路径搜索阶段，目标点特化范围半径
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the goal point, during path search

NAVIGATION.description: 起始特化范围内点位与障碍物距离，适配起始点接近障碍物的情况
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the start-point specialized radius, for cases where the starting point is close to an obstacle

NAVIGATION.description: 目标特化范围内点位与障碍物距离，适配目标点接近障碍物的情况
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the goal-point specialized radius, for cases where the goal is close to an obstacle

NAVIGATION.description: 路径搜索失败（通路被阻挡）时，是否返回可行域内距目标点最近的部分路径；目标点在货架/墙壁对面等场景慎用，可能出现"走错位置"的观感
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to return the feasible partial path closest to the goal when path search fails (path blocked); use with caution when the goal is behind a shelf/wall, as it can look like the robot went to the wrong place

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 路径控制点与障碍物距离（软约束）；应大于搜索阶段的安全距离，一般大 0.2~0.5m
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept between path control points and obstacles (soft constraint); should be greater than the search-phase safety distance, typically by 0.2~0.5m

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 起始特化范围内点位与障碍物距离
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the start-point specialized radius

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 目标特化范围内点位与障碍物距离
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance to obstacles within the goal-point specialized radius

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹优化阶段，起始点特化范围
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the start point, during trajectory optimization

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹优化阶段，目标点特化范围
NAVIGATION.description_en: Specialized radius around the goal point, during trajectory optimization

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹优化后验硬约束：最终规划路径点与障碍物距离小于该值则判定规划失败
NAVIGATION.description_en: Post-optimization hard constraint: planning is judged to have failed if the final planned path's distance to an obstacle is below this value

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.description: 障碍物距离权重（安全性权重），默认以安全性为优先，数值越大越优先避障
NAVIGATION.description_en: Obstacle-distance weight (safety weight); by default safety is prioritized, and a larger value further prioritizes obstacle avoidance

NAVIGATION.group: 轨迹优化（安全距离与平滑度）
NAVIGATION.range: 数值越大轨迹越平滑，20.0~50.0 通常有较好效果
NAVIGATION.description: 轨迹平滑性权重；场景宽敞、无需贴近障碍物时可适当调高以提升导航流畅度
NAVIGATION.description_en: Trajectory smoothness weight; can be increased in open scenes that don't require hugging obstacles closely, to improve navigation smoothness

NAVIGATION.description: 导航执行时，沿规划路径基于机器人当前位置向前预测检测碰撞的距离；预测距离过大易导致频繁重规划、运动卡顿或抖动
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance ahead of the robot's current position, along the planned path, over which collisions are predicted during navigation execution; too large a value can cause frequent replanning or jerky/stuttering motion

NAVIGATION.description: 规划完成时是否检测全轨迹（圆柱包络）碰撞可行性，不可行则不下发控制执行；高动态响应/无图长程导航等场景可关闭，改为运行时碰撞预测+动态重规划配合使用
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to check the full trajectory (cylindrical envelope) for collision feasibility once planning completes, and withhold execution if infeasible; can be disabled in high dynamic-response or mapless long-range navigation scenarios in favor of runtime collision prediction + dynamic replanning

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.range: 长度 3，单位 m/s、rad/s，元素范围 (0, 1.5)
NAVIGATION.description: 导航规划最大速度 [vx, vy, w]；需同步保证机器人控制端速度上限不小于此值，否则可能出现跟踪不上的情况
NAVIGATION.description_en: Maximum navigation planning velocity [vx, vy, w]; the robot's control-side velocity limit must be kept no lower than this value, otherwise the robot may fail to track the planned velocity
NAVIGATION.range_en: length 3, in m/s and rad/s, element range (0, 1.5)

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 导航规划最大加速度 [ax, ay, aw]；一般不修改
NAVIGATION.description_en: Maximum navigation planning acceleration [ax, ay, aw]; normally left unchanged

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 导航规划最大加加速度 [jx, jy, jw]；一般不修改
NAVIGATION.description_en: Maximum navigation planning jerk [jx, jy, jw]; normally left unchanged

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用向心加速度约束
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable the centripetal acceleration constraint

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 向心加速度约束上限
NAVIGATION.description_en: Upper bound for the centripetal acceleration constraint

NAVIGATION.group: 速度、加速度与控制周期
NAVIGATION.description: 规划路点时间间隔（控制周期），决定路点密集程度
NAVIGATION.description_en: Time interval between planned waypoints (control cycle), determining how densely waypoints are packed

NAVIGATION.description: 到达位置误差（X 方向）；需保证机器人控制精度小于此处到位误差，否则会触发无法到位问题，控制精度不宜小于 1cm
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival position error (X direction); the robot's control accuracy must be smaller than this arrival error, otherwise the robot may fail to reach the target; control accuracy should not be smaller than 1cm

NAVIGATION.description: 到达位置误差（Y 方向）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival position error (Y direction)

NAVIGATION.description: 到达角度误差
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival orientation error

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用全向规划（同时平移与旋转）；关闭时为常规航向导航（先转向再直行）。受限于雷达可视范围，全向运动背对障碍物行进时存在碰撞风险，需结合场景判断是否开启。S1 机型传入会返回 INVALID_INPUT
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable omnidirectional planning (simultaneous translation and rotation); when disabled, standard heading-based navigation (turn first, then move straight) is used. Due to limited lidar field of view, moving omnidirectionally with an obstacle behind the robot carries a collision risk -- enable based on the scene. On S1 this returns INVALID_INPUT

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m（G系列默认 0.2，S1 默认 0.5）
NAVIGATION.description: 短位移判定阈值：当前位置与目标位置距离小于该值时，采用短位移运动方式
NAVIGATION.description_en: Short-distance-move threshold: once the distance between the current position and target is below this value, the short-distance motion mode is used

NAVIGATION.description: 短位移运动方式：0=全向（G系列），1=蟹行+旋转，2=旋转+蟹行（S1 推荐，避免关节碰撞）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Short-distance motion mode: 0=omnidirectional (G-series), 1=crab-walk + rotate, 2=rotate + crab-walk (recommended for S1, avoids joint collisions)

NAVIGATION.description: 是否优先尝试全向（S1 为旋转+蟹行）直线运动到达，无碰撞则执行，否则进入常规规划流程
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to first attempt a straight-line omnidirectional move (rotate + crab-walk on S1) to the goal, executing it if collision-free, otherwise falling back to regular planning

NAVIGATION.description: 尝试全向直线路点与障碍物保持的距离
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept from obstacles for the straight-line omnidirectional waypoints attempted above

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m；≥0 生效（建议 0.2），<0 关闭
NAVIGATION.description: 规划首末位置与障碍物（机器人或指定 link 圆柱包络表面）保持的距离；需结合 find_valid_pos_step 一并设置
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept between the start/end positions and obstacles (the robot's or a specified link's cylindrical envelope surface) during planning; should be set together with find_valid_pos_step
NAVIGATION.range_en: in m; ≥0 enables it (recommended 0.2), <0 disables it

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m；≥0 生效（建议 0.05），<0 关闭
NAVIGATION.description: 首末与障碍物保持距离无法达成（窄通道）时，搜索最佳安全距离的步长；需结合 dis_with_obstacle 一并设置
NAVIGATION.description_en: Step size for searching the best safe distance when the requested start/end obstacle clearance can't be achieved (narrow corridors); should be set together with dis_with_obstacle
NAVIGATION.range_en: in m; ≥0 enables it (recommended 0.05), <0 disables it

NAVIGATION.description: 起点查找远离点时，纳入包络检测的 link 列表
NAVIGATION.description_en: Link list included in envelope checking when searching for a clearance point near the start

NAVIGATION.description: 终点查找远离点时，纳入包络检测的 link 列表；指定较小的 link 列表可避免上身姿态臂展较大时圆柱包络半径过大而插入冗余过渡点
NAVIGATION.description_en: Link list included in envelope checking when searching for a clearance point near the goal; a smaller link list avoids inserting redundant transition points caused by an oversized cylindrical envelope when the upper body's arm span is large

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用脱困调整（导航规划路径碰撞时进入脱困策略）；开启时若同时开启静态地图规划，停障功能将失效
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable recovery adjustment (entering a recovery strategy when the planned path collides); when enabled, if static-map planning is also enabled, the stop-on-obstacle behavior stops working

NAVIGATION.description: 脱困策略尝试顺序：0=指定过渡点导航，1=直接全向（S1 为旋转+蟹行）直线到达，2=按碰撞位置搜索可原地旋转点，3=按碰撞位置分类处理
NAVIGATION.description_en: Order in which recovery strategies are attempted: 0=navigate to a designated transition point, 1=go straight omnidirectionally (rotate + crab-walk on S1), 2=search for an in-place rotation point based on the collision location, 3=handle by collision-location category

NAVIGATION.description: 到达远离障碍物过渡点尝试的运动方式，按配置顺序依次尝试：0=全向（G系列），1=蟹行+旋转，2=旋转+蟹行
NAVIGATION.description_en: Motion modes attempted, in configured order, to reach a transition point away from the obstacle: 0=omnidirectional (G-series), 1=crab-walk + rotate, 2=rotate + crab-walk

NAVIGATION.description: 指定脱困过渡点位姿列表，每项为 [x,y,yaw] 或 [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,rw]；设置多个时选运行耗时最短的可行点
NAVIGATION.description_en: List of designated recovery transition-point poses, each [x,y,yaw] or [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,rw]; when multiple are set, the fastest feasible one is chosen

NAVIGATION.description: 是否保存每次导航的过程数据（动态地图、碰撞时局部地图、规划路径），用于问题复现与可视化排查
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to save each navigation run's process data (dynamic map, local map at time of collision, planned path), for reproducing issues and visual debugging

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用动态连续重规划（Beta）：开启后重规划时不下发停止指令，以上一次轨迹执行位置为起始条件连续重规划，避障运动更连续；关闭（默认）则先停止底盘再重规划

NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to check the full trajectory (cylindrical envelope) for collision feasibility once planning completes, and withhold execution if infeasible; can be disabled in high dynamic-response or mapless long-range navigation scenarios in favor of runtime collision prediction + dynamic replanning

NAVIGATION.range_en: length 3, in m/s and rad/s, element range (0, 1.5)

NAVIGATION.description: 到达位置误差（X 方向）；需保证机器人控制精度小于此处到位误差，否则会触发无法到位问题，控制精度不宜小于 1cm

NAVIGATION.description: 到达位置误差（Y 方向）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival position error (Y direction)

NAVIGATION.description: 到达角度误差
NAVIGATION.description_en: Arrival orientation error

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用全向规划（同时平移与旋转）；关闭时为常规航向导航（先转向再直行）。受限于雷达可视范围，全向运动背对障碍物行进时存在碰撞风险，需结合场景判断是否开启。S1 机型传入会返回 INVALID_INPUT
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable omnidirectional planning (simultaneous translation and rotation); when disabled, standard heading-based navigation (turn first, then move straight) is used. Due to limited lidar field of view, moving omnidirectionally with an obstacle behind the robot carries a collision risk -- enable based on the scene. On S1 this returns INVALID_INPUT

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m（G系列 默认 0.2，S1 默认 0.5）
NAVIGATION.description: 短位移判定阈值：当前位置与目标位置距离小于该值时，采用短位移运动方式
NAVIGATION.description_en: Short-distance-move threshold: once the distance between the current position and target is below this value, the short-distance motion mode is used

NAVIGATION.description: 短位移运动方式：0=全向（G系列），1=蟹行+旋转，2=旋转+蟹行（S1 推荐，避免关节碰撞）
NAVIGATION.description_en: Short-distance motion mode: 0=omnidirectional (G-series), 1=crab-walk + rotate, 2=rotate + crab-walk (recommended for S1, avoids joint collisions)

NAVIGATION.description: 是否优先尝试全向（S1 为旋转+蟹行）直线运动到达，无碰撞则执行，否则进入常规规划流程

NAVIGATION.description: 尝试全向直线路点与障碍物保持的距离
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept from obstacles for the straight-line omnidirectional waypoints attempted above

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m；≥0 生效（建议 0.2），<0 关闭
NAVIGATION.description: 规划首末位置与障碍物（机器人或指定 link 圆柱包络表面）保持的距离；需结合 find_valid_pos_step 一并设置
NAVIGATION.description_en: Distance kept between the start/end positions and obstacles (the robot's or a specified link's cylindrical envelope surface) during planning; should be set together with find_valid_pos_step
NAVIGATION.range_en: in m; ≥0 enables it (recommended 0.2), <0 disables it

NAVIGATION.range: 单位 m；≥0 生效（建议 0.05），<0 关闭
NAVIGATION.description: 首末与障碍物保持距离无法达成（窄通道）时，搜索最佳安全距离的步长；需结合 dis_with_obstacle 一并设置
NAVIGATION.description_en: Step size for searching the best safe distance when the requested start/end obstacle clearance can't be achieved (narrow corridors); should be set together with dis_with_obstacle
NAVIGATION.range_en: in m; ≥0 enables it (recommended 0.05), <0 disables it

NAVIGATION.description: 起点查找远离点时，纳入包络检测的 link 列表
NAVIGATION.description_en: Link list included in envelope checking when searching for a clearance point near the start

NAVIGATION.description: 终点查找远离点时，纳入包络检测的 link 列表；指定较小的 link 列表可避免上身姿态臂展较大时圆柱包络半径过大而插入冗余过渡点
NAVIGATION.description_en: Link list included in envelope checking when searching for a clearance point near the goal; a smaller link list avoids inserting redundant transition points caused by an oversized cylindrical envelope when the upper body's arm span is large

NAVIGATION.description: 是否启用脱困调整（导航规划路径碰撞时进入脱困策略）；开启时若同时开启静态地图规划，停障功能将失效
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to enable recovery adjustment (entering a recovery strategy when the planned path collides); when enabled, if static-map planning is also enabled, the stop-on-obstacle behavior stops working

NAVIGATION.description: 脱困策略尝试顺序：0=指定过渡点导航，1=直接全向（S1 为旋转+蟹行）直线到达，2=按碰撞位置搜索可原地旋转点，3=按碰撞位置分类处理
NAVIGATION.description_en: Order in which recovery strategies are attempted: 0=navigate to a designated transition point, 1=go straight omnidirectionally (rotate + crab-walk on S1), 2=search for an in-place rotation point based on the collision location, 3=handle by collision-location category

NAVIGATION.description: 到达远离障碍物过渡点尝试的运动方式，按配置顺序依次尝试：0=全向（G系列），1=蟹行+旋转，2=旋转+蟹行
NAVIGATION.description_en: Motion modes attempted, in configured order, to reach a transition point away from the obstacle: 0=omnidirectional (G-series), 1=crab-walk + rotate, 2=rotate + crab-walk

NAVIGATION.description: 指定脱困过渡点位姿列表，每项为 [x,y,yaw] 或 [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,rw]；设置多个时选运行耗时最短的可行点
NAVIGATION.description_en: List of designated recovery transition-point poses, each [x,y,yaw] or [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,rw]; when multiple are set, the fastest feasible one is chosen

NAVIGATION.description: 是否保存每次导航的过程数据（动态地图、碰撞时局部地图、规划路径），用于问题复现与可视化排查
NAVIGATION.description_en: Whether to save each navigation run's process data (dynamic map, local map at time of collision, planned path), for reproducing issues and visual debugging
